source: Model benchmark reference baseline based on approximate closing prices (Unverified against real exchange ticks)
warning: These base prices are synthetic reference seeds used for deterministic testing and simulation. They do not represent live exchange market closes and should be verified against historical closing data.
audit_discrepancy_warning: AUDIT NOTE: In the live-captured provider sample (docs/live_sample_capture_20261013.json), TCS was recorded at ~2269.45 INR, whereas this baseline holds 4100.00 INR. This difference will cause severe indicator skew if state generated under one price baseline is mixed with candles from another.
